pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal to sub-rounded geometry with predominantly smooth pixel-level gradients at the edges. The patches exhibit a consistent spatial area across the mid-flank, becoming progressively smaller and more fragmented toward the posterior and ventral margins.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous negative-space lattice of light-colored pelage with a thickness ranging between approximately 10-25 pixels. The graph is characterized by high continuity and distinct tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the cervical margin. The mane consists of dense, vertically oriented hair clusters creating a serrated 1D contour against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A prominent structural discontinuity or dip in the mane line is visible at the transition point between the posterior neck and the shoulder region.
